claim.lead: Envoy gives AI agents a phone layer: the ability to act inside any phone app, and to understand what those apps contain.
claim.pitch: Agents can search the web. Your phone knows your life.
claim.prior: Operating phone apps with an agent has been done (Mobilerun, Gemini on Android, AGI Inc.). Envoy's contribution is making it dependable, cheap and useful over time:

new.title: App routines
new.text: One successful run is compiled into a reusable program with inputs, a check before and after every step, element-based targeting that works on any screen size, and self-repair that fixes only the broken step and saves the fix.

new.title: A trustworthy shared memory
new.text: Facts pulled from app screens, email and photos land in one graph. Each fact records where and when it was seen, newer facts replace stale ones, and the same trip seen in an email and an app becomes one entity.

new.title: A device layer that routes between phones
new.text: One interface over cloud emulators and real Android phones, with routines that run on either. The iPhone acts as a companion for approvals, the live view, voice and photos.
